label: Card lists
description: Bordered cards side by side, each a title, an optional sentence and a bulleted list — the blog's OEM-versus-aftermarket pair and its preventive-maintenance groups and the mileage interval cards. One card per item, each with its own list of points, so a card or a point is added in the list editor rather than by copying a box.

options.label: Comparison — roomy, the title set well down
Group — compact, the title at the top
Interval — four across, the title as a small accent label
Feature — three across, a title and a sentence
Feature, two across — a title and a sentence
Spec — two across, a title over short bold-led points
Series — three across, a small accent label over one line
Numbered — three across, a small number over a short heading
Type — two across, roomy, a lead-in in bold before the list
Option — three across, a small accent label before the list
Cost — one per row, a closing note under the list
Numbered — two across, a large number over the title

fields.label: Sentence under the title (optional, may carry a link)
